description: CommSync puts a team's business texting and email in one shared inbox: every phone line (Twilio, JustCall, Quo, RingCentral, Telnyx, and more) and every mailbox (Gmail, Outlook, any IMAP account), with contacts that tie a person's numbers and addresses together. Connect it to ChatGPT to search and read your SMS and email conversations, triage threads, reply by text or email, and keep contacts tidy, all from the lines you choose when you sign in. Access follows your role in your workspace, and you can disconnect at any time.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my unread texts and emails from today
Find everything a contact said by text or email this month
